```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
conc <- read.csv("carbamazepine_Dec_concentrations.csv", header = T)
```

```{r}
conc <- subset(conc, Sample_type != "Blank")
conc <-filter(conc, Sample_name!=  "Before_chlorination")
conc <-filter(conc, Sample_name!=  "After_chlorination")
conc <-filter(conc, Sample_name!=  "Buffalo_Park")

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Perform Kruskal-Wallis test for each unique molecule
kruskal_results <- conc %>%
  group_by(Molecule) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = list(kruskal.test(Concentration_ng_L ~ `Snow_Type`, data = cur_data())$p.value)
  ) %>%
  unnest(p_value)

# Print results
print(kruskal_results)
```

```{r}
dunn_results <- conc %>%
  group_by(Molecule) %>%
  summarise(
    dunn_test = list(FSA::dunnTest(Concentration_ng_L ~ Snow_Type, data = cur_data(), method = "bonferroni")$res)
  ) %>%
  unnest(dunn_test)  # Unnest results for easy viewing

print(dunn_results)
```
